oracle_principles: Dependencies are bound to immutable logical identity plus exact predecessor outcome comment and body digest.
Only a unique immutable COMPLETED predecessor outcome can satisfy a dependency.
Blocked is not empty and is never closable.
GitHub observation must be stable under order permutation and fail closed on membership/content instability.
Exactly one runnable node is elected; parallel execution is outside Gate 2.
Durable JOB_STARTED is a replay fence and ambiguous recovery remains human-governed.

scenarios.description: Direct A -> A cycle must be rejected.
Two-node A -> B -> A cycle must be rejected.
Longer cycle must be rejected.
Dependency references a node absent from the graph.
The same predecessor cannot be listed twice in one fan-in.
Same logical job_id with a different request digest is a hard identity conflict.
Same request digest cannot appear under incompatible logical job identities.

A blocked descendant is pending work and must not be interpreted as an empty queue.
A close attempt while blocked work exists must fail closed.
Different comment membership across required scans is unstable and must fail closed.

Ambiguous authoritative state after a started effect remains RECOVERY_REQUIRED.

Boundary B: outcome body changed while retaining comment_id; RECOVERY_REQUIRED, zero Gate0 invocation, zero automatic replay.

Boundary B: unique predecessor terminal becomes ambiguous; RECOVERY_REQUIRED, zero Gate0 invocation, zero automatic replay.

Boundary B: selected descendant source request is edited or replaced; RECOVERY_REQUIRED, zero Gate0 invocation, zero automatic replay.

Boundary B: graph payload/digest binding changes; RECOVERY_REQUIRED, zero Gate0 invocation, zero automatic replay.

Boundary B: graph declaration comment is edited; RECOVERY_REQUIRED, zero Gate0 invocation, zero automatic replay.
A prior RUNNABLE projection cannot substitute for fresh Boundary A reconstruction.
Gate1 final_effect_guard() alone cannot substitute for Gate2 Boundary B reconstruction.
A previously observed receipt cannot substitute for rereading receipt, terminal and outcome.
Cross-authority dependency scope is forbidden.
Cross-request-issue dependency scope is forbidden.
Two graph nodes with the same node id are rejected deterministically.
A graph with a COMPLETED terminal still awaiting a valid receipt is not COMPLETE.
Divergent valid receipt candidates cause global hold and never a Gate0 replay.
Any predecessor output substitution into descendant request bytes is forbidden.

declared_design_contract.outcome_binding: authoritative comment_id + SHA-256(exact UTF-8 body) + existing Gate0 internal validation
declared_design_contract.complete_semantics: COMPLETE only when every node is SUCCEEDED
declared_design_contract.boundary_a: fresh complete revalidation after durable JOB_SELECTED and before JOB_STARTED
declared_design_contract.boundary_b: fresh complete revalidation after durable JOB_STARTED immediately before Gate0
cache_shortcuts_forbidden: previously observed receipt without terminal/outcome reread
